weighting.quintic: Static torque sampled on common smooth quintic useful height, zero dwell; normalized time; no dynamic inertia
weighting.actuator: Direct hip equivalent throughout; equivalent knee magnitude is hip/guide; motor gearing separate

domain.objective: height-weighted static hip RMS; no weighted score
